tint_policy: Only white accent-mask quads receive the contained-item color; print and cardboard remain untinted.
texture_layout: Untinted atlas in top half, matching white alpha accent masks in bottom half.

dynamic_label.transform: Apply the block facing rotation about block center. In north-local coordinates, text screen-right points toward negative X; text screen-down points toward negative Y. Place the text plane at z=3.985/16, in front of the untinted navy footer. Center the measured line and scale it to fit the region.
dynamic_label.overflow: Scale to fit; preserve Component text and use the minecraft:default font fallback for remaining Unicode.

contents.note: Fit the complete transformed item or mob miniature bounds inside the window; the cardboard tray top is y=0.59.

item_model: minecraft:builtin/entity; custom item renderer draws this shell block model and the stored contents.
